mangrove.purpose: Reading, aggregating and submitting open, signed place reviews via the Mangrove.reviews network
mangrove.dataSent: On read: a geo: subject URI with the place's coordinates and an uncertainty radius (no place name). On submit: a user-signed review JWT (rating, opinion, metadata). On image upload: the attached image file
mangrove.dataReceived: Signed reviews for the subject (rating, opinion, images, author key and nickname, timestamps) and uploaded image URLs

mangrove-signer.purpose: Optional login and delegated review signing with the official Mangrove signer. The signer can decrypt the private key and sign on your behalf; this is not end-to-end encryption or protection against a compromised signer.
mangrove-signer.dataSent: Browser redirect: registered client ID, callback URL, login provider, random state and optional Bluesky handle. Provider login is handled by Mangrove. Authenticated relay: session token and, when signing, review content. Tokens are not stored by OpenMapX.
mangrove-signer.dataReceived: Session token in the browser callback; reviewer ID, public signing key, optional DID and provider account name; signed review JWT; revocation result.
